interval_calibration.copy_rule: margins read 'at least this wide', never plus-or-minus

rule.wobble: mean rank move of the cities in the top 10 of either the published or the replicate ranking, averaged over the 80 replicates
rule.verdict: fail if total wobble over the touched searches exceeds 1.10 x the reference's; all searches when nothing is touched

adversarial_artifacts.rule: a watchlist metro in a top-10 fails if > 15% of that persona's pool there is noninstitutional GQ

rank_stability_overlap_old_rule.rule: soft (ADR 0011): the >= 8-of-10 overlap in >= 80% of replicates, every persona

weight_sensitivity.note: six pillars since m2.1.0. Read tau AGAINST the weight: students (0.04) and weather (0.06) clear the bar largely because ±20% of a small weight moves few ranks — that is arithmetic, not robustness, and is reported as such.

external_correlation.b12007_finding: B12007 returns annotation jams for every CBSA in 2024 acs/acs5 — median age at first marriage is not published at metro level; state-level medians used through each metro's primary state
external_correlation.framing: the index measures opportunity, not outcome; partnership outcomes reflect decades of sorting and migration, so weak correlation is expected and reported as measured (§11)

intermarriage_pums.reference: Census PUMS newlywed intermarriage rate (ADR 0016; results/phase4/intermarriage_pums_metro.csv), metros with at least 200 newlyweds in sample
intermarriage_pums.predictions: C1_cohorts_plus_shipped's leave-one-metro-out record on decay_h5 (Phase 3d A2, the finished fit): each metro left out, its out-group share predicted from the national kernel refitted without it and its own composition
